{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the cross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment to check for confounding
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))"}
